definitions.explanation: One's social standing, honor, or dignity in the eyes of others. Often used in expressions about saving or losing face.

examples.japanese: {面目|めんぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧
{面目|めんぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I can't save face./I'm losing my credibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}して→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧、{面目|めんぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}った→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: He recovered from his failure and saved face.

notes:
ALTERNATIVE READING: Also commonly read as めんもく.

USAGE: Often appears in set expressions about honor and reputation. Can be used with various verbs to describe gaining, losing, or maintaining face.

NUANCE: {面目|めんぼく} relates to social reputation and dignity—how one is perceived by others. It's an important concept in Japanese social relations.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {面目|めんぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose face)
- {面目|めんぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧/⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to save/lose face)
- {面目|めんぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (to maintain one's honor)
- {面目|めんぼく}{丸|まる}{潰|つぶ}れ (complete loss of face)
- {面目|めんぼく}{躍如|やくじょ} (showing one's true worth)
- ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to be too ashamed to face someone)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{体面|たいめん}→体面：18817_taimen⟧ (honor, dignity - more formal)
- ⟦{体裁|ていさい}→体裁：09154_teisai⟧ (appearance, keeping up appearances)
- ⟦{世間体|せけんてい}→世間体：09157_sekentei⟧ (reputation in society)
- ⟦{沽券|こけん}→沽券：09156_koken⟧ (dignity, reputation)
